subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should a Feishu source-message recall be treated as revoking authorization for any still-running agent work, with the 231003 typing-target signal retained only as a source-message-specific fallback?
rationale: This determines the user-visible cancellation contract and the acceptable trade-off between stopping post-recall work and accidentally suppressing a valid response after a transient or unrelated Feishu error.

options.title: Adopt bounded cancellation
options.body: Approve recall-triggered cancellation for source-bound Feishu runs, preserve the source-message-only fallback, and require final-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Event-only cancellation
options.body: Use only the explicit im.message.recalled_v1 event and remove the typing-error fallback if the service-error signal is not an accepted cancellation authority.

options.title: Suppress replies only
options.body: Keep agent execution running after recall and limit the behavior to avoiding post-recall visible replies.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded cancellation
recommendation.body: Approve recall-triggered cancellation for source-bound Feishu runs, preserve the source-message-only fallback, and require final-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on Feishu inbound routing makes this the strongest available area-routing signal.
